# Preview-parity test (issue #7, docs/design/designer.md section 2): the IR evaluator runs a native
# handler's TSX preview body, generated C++ runs the developer's code, and the runner compares the
# state of the two after every step of a script.
#
# Host-only, like the compiler demo: the generated sample is regenerated by running the codegen CLI
# at build time, and a cross-compiling build cannot run a target binary.
if (CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING OR NOT TARGET tessera_codegen_cli)
    return()
endif ()

add_library(tessera_parity_runner STATIC parity_runner.cpp)
target_include_directories(tessera_parity_runner PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR})
target_link_libraries(tessera_parity_runner PUBLIC tessera_ir_eval tessera_scene)
target_compile_features(tessera_parity_runner PUBLIC cxx_std_23)

add_executable(parity_runner_tests parity_runner_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(parity_runner_tests PRIVATE tessera_parity_runner)
add_test(NAME parity_runner COMMAND parity_runner_tests)

# The sample: the generated base is written into the build dir from Counter.tsx (ADR-040); the
# developer class (its `add` is the C++ twin of the preview body) is committed in the sample dir.
set(_parity_dir ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated)
set(_parity_sample_dir ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/samples/parity-demo)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${_parity_dir}/Counter.g.hpp
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${_parity_dir}
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tessera_codegen_cli> --mode base --write
            --out ${_parity_dir} --namespace parity_sample ${_parity_sample_dir}/Counter.tsx
    DEPENDS tessera_codegen_cli ${_parity_sample_dir}/Counter.tsx
            ${_parity_sample_dir}/tessera.json
    COMMENT "Generating the preview-parity sample base"
    VERBATIM)

add_library(tessera_parity_counter STATIC ${_parity_sample_dir}/Counter.cpp
    ${_parity_dir}/Counter.g.hpp)
target_include_directories(tessera_parity_counter PUBLIC ${_parity_sample_dir} ${_parity_dir})
target_link_libraries(tessera_parity_counter PUBLIC tessera_scene tessera_text_edit)

add_executable(preview_parity_tests preview_parity_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(preview_parity_tests PRIVATE
    tessera_parity_runner tessera_parity_counter tessera_lowering tessera_ir_ids)
target_compile_definitions(preview_parity_tests PRIVATE
    TESSERA_PARITY_SAMPLE_DIR="${_parity_sample_dir}")
add_test(NAME preview_parity COMMAND preview_parity_tests)
